verdict.rationale: A community report says Fastmail itself can fetch mail from and send via a Gmail account like a mail client, which is a product-side way to work an external provider's account from Fastmail. No first-party docs in the pack describe this, and nothing covers Microsoft 365 or generic IMAP accounts. 'Import your mail' is a one-off migration, and 'Logging in to multiple accounts' is a bare title that does not show cross-provider aggregation. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of external account fetching/sending, explicit Microsoft 365 and generic IMAP support, evidence of managing several external accounts together in one unified view, and hands-on corroboration beyond a single comment.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can connect several accounts across providers — Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP — and work them from one place

citations.quote: you can configure Fastmail to fetch mail from (and send via) Gmail like a mail client.
